COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
AO No.58 of 2026
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Heard Mr. Sahil Mullick, learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
2. The present appeal from order under Order 43 Rule 1(d) of 
the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, has been preferred against the 
impugned order dated 15.04.2025 passed by learned 4th
Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division), Dehradun in Misc. 
Case No.175 of 2023, titled as “Smt. Sheila Sandhu vs. Harjinder 
Singh Deol & Anr.” and entire proceedings of the Execution 
Case No.52 of 2021 in Original Suit No.283 of 2008 “Shri Karan 
Deol vs. Sanjay Singh Sandhu & Anr.” Pending in the court of 
learned 3rd Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division), Dehradun 
be quashed. 
3. Since Article 116 of the Limitation Act, 1963, stipulates a 
90 days limitation period for filing an appeal and the period 
begins from the date of the decree or order, the present appeal is 
time-barred.
4. At this juncture, learned counsel for the appellant seeks 
and is granted two weeks time to file appropriate application 
seeking condonation of delay. 
5. List this matter on 19.03.2026.
 (Siddhartha Sah, J.) 
 27.02.2026
Akash
